name: Fee Paid
next_step_note: Your course fee payment has been received. Please wait for an update on the next stage of the process.

name: Rejected
next_step_note: Your application was not successful at this stage. Please check the communication sent to you for further details.

name: Entrance Test Allocated
next_step_note: Please attend the entrance test on the scheduled date.

name: Completed
next_step_note: You have successfully completed and submitted your application. Please follow the instructions provided to proceed with the next stage of the admission process

name: Merit Selected
next_step_note: Congratulations! Your application has been selected based on the published merit list. Please proceed to the next stage of the admission process as instructed.

name: Merit Rejected
next_step_note: Unfortunately, your application was not selected based on the merit list. Please check the communication sent to you for more information and any further instructions, if applicable.

name: Merit Waitlisted
next_step_note: You have been placed on the waitlist. Please await further communication, as your admission status may change subject to seat availability.

name: Seat Waitlisted
next_step_note: Your application has been placed on the waitlist for seat allocation. Please await further communication, as your admission status may change subject to seat availability.

name: Offer Accepted
next_step_note: Congratulations! A seat has been allocated to you. Please complete the admission fee payment to confirm your seat and proceed with the admission process.

name: Offer Issued
next_step_note: Your offer letter has been issued. Please review it and respond within the given timeframe.

name: Offer Declined
next_step_note: You have declined the offer. No further action is required unless stated otherwise.

name: Offer Expired
next_step_note: The offer validity period has passed without a response. Please check the communication sent to you for further details.

name: Interview Scheduled
next_step_note: Your interview has been scheduled. Please review the interview details and ensure that you are available to attend on the specified date and time.

name: Interview Rejected
next_step_note: Unfortunately, you have not qualified at the interview stage. Please check the communication sent to you for more information and any further instructions, if applicable.

name: Merit Published
next_step_note: The merit list has been published. Please check your position and status.

name: Enrolled
next_step_note: Congratulations! Your enrollment has been completed successfully. You will receive further instructions regarding onboarding and the next steps shortly.

name: Withdrawn
next_step_note: Your enrollment has been withdrawn in accordance with the applicable policies. Please review the official communication provided for additional information.

name: Entrance Test Scheduled
next_step_note: Your entrance examination has been scheduled. Please review the examination details and ensure that you are present at the designated venue on the specified date and time.

name: Seat Selected
next_step_note: Congratulations! A seat has been allotted to you. Please proceed with the next stage of the admission process by following the instructions provided.

name: Seat Rejected
next_step_note: Unfortunately, a seat could not be allocated to you. Please check the communication sent to you for more information and any further instructions, if applicable.

name: Draft
next_step_note: Your application has not yet been completed. Kindly provide the remaining required information and submit your application before the application deadline

name: Submitted
next_step_note: Your application has been successfully received. To complete your application and continue with the admission process, please pay the application fee if it is still outstanding

name: Entrance Test Rejected
next_step_note: Unfortunately, you have not qualified at the entrance examination stage. Please check the communication sent to you for more information and any further instructions, if applicable.

name: Interview Completed
next_step_note: You have successfully completed the interview process. Please await further communication regarding the next stage of the admission process.

name: Interview Exempted
next_step_note: You have been exempted from the interview. Please proceed with the next stage of the admission process in accordance with the instructions provided.

name: Entrance Test Exempted
next_step_note: You have been granted an exemption from the entrance examination. Please proceed to the next stage of the admission process as instructed.

name: Entrance Test Completed
next_step_note: Thank you for completing the entrance examination. You will be notified about the next stage of the admission process once the results are available.
